summary.text: Katrina Sexton is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 55 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Kim King.
An educator and former Burgin Independent school board member, she won the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary and also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Katrina Sexton was born in Danville, Kentucky, and earned an associate degree from St. Catharine College in 2000, a bachelor's degree from Eastern Kentucky University in 2004, and a Ph.D. from Eastern Kentucky University in 2016.
Her career experience includes working as an educator.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has worked as a farmhand, social services worker, hospital associate, retail worker, factory line worker, and educator in public K-12 schools and in higher education, and that she was twice elected to a city council and twice elected to the school board in Burgin, Kentucky.
In 2024, Sexton ran in the general election for Kentucky House District 55 and received 26.6% of the vote to incumbent Kim King's 73.4%.
She defeated Nathan Saucedo in the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary, 57.6% to 42.4%.
In the Ballotpedia survey, she named protecting public education, affordable and accessible healthcare, and protecting individual, worker, and citizen rights as her policy priorities.
